recipe.title: Creamy Greek Chicken Bowl
recipe.summary: A fast Costco-friendly Greek chicken bowl with grilled chicken, crisp vegetables, feta, Kalamata olives, and a creamy homemade Greek yogurt dressing for approximately 44 grams of protein and 400 calories.
recipe.story: This is one of those bowls I make by feel because the ingredients are simple and the flavors do the work. A full pack of grilled chicken makes the protein easy, and the creamy Greek dressing comes together with nonfat Greek yogurt, red wine vinegar, a tiny bit of olive oil, and Cavender's Greek seasoning. It tastes like a real lunch, not a diet meal, and most of the ingredients are useful for other meals too.
ingredients: 1 Fresh Additions fully cooked chicken breast bites pack, 100 grams
4 Mezzetta pitted Greek Kalamata olives, sliced
1/2 cup Kirkland Signature Organic plain nonfat Greek yogurt
1/2 teaspoon Cavender's All Purpose Greek Seasoning
1 to 2 teaspoons water, as needed to thin the dressing
instructions: Add the leafy greens to a large bowl and top with the cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, Kalamata olives, feta, and the full pack of grilled chicken breast bites.
In a small bowl, stir together the Greek yogurt, red wine vinegar, olive oil, and Cavender's Greek seasoning until creamy.
Add 1 to 2 teaspoons of water if needed to thin the dressing to your preferred consistency.
Spoon the creamy Greek dressing over the bowl, toss lightly, and serve.
tips: The full individual chicken pack keeps the portion simple and makes this an easy workday lunch.
Start with a small amount of water in the dressing and add more only if needed.
The tiny amount of olive oil adds flavor and richness without taking over the calorie budget.
Nutrition is approximate and may vary with current product labels and the exact vegetables used.
